headline: Reserve Bank of India Schedules ₹50,000 Crore VRRR Liquidity Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India will conduct a 1-day Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction for ₹50,000 crore to manage short-term interbank liquidity conditions.
why: VRRR auctions are the RBI's main instrument for absorbing excess short-term cash from the Indian banking system.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: RBI initiated liquidity absorption through a reverse repo auction.
